what: When the filter row (watch) at the head of the list scrolls off the top, a bar holding the same buttons slides down from the top. The bar descends from one full height above (−100%) at .5 opacity over .4s cubic-bezier(.24,1,.35,.98) while sharpening, and the inner row unfolds with it from −10% and .99 scale (.98 on narrow screens). When the filter row is visible again the bar goes back up, and once fully up it is removed.

options.offset: The watch line must move this many px higher before it sticks — the height of a fixed header if there is one, default 0
options.scale: Size of the inner line before it expands, default .99 (.98 below 660)
options.--fx-ease: Curve (css variable, on the strip), default cubic-bezier(.24,1,.35,.98)
options.--fx-bg: Band background (css variable), default background color 80%
options.[data-fx-part=watch]: (If present) row to watch — if none, the element carrying the motion part
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Sticky band — place it inside the element that carries the part (fixed)
options.[data-fx-part=inner]: (If present) line that unfolds inside the band

from.where: news.html News header filter (topic picker · publication year) — a fixed bar turned on by the IntersectionObserver of the original /common/dist/news/list: rgba(0,0,0,.8) · transform .4s cubic-bezier(.24,1,.35,.98) · opacity .4s, inner translateY(-10%) scale(.99 / phone .98)
